title: Saving Money
text: Tom wants to buy a new bike. The bike costs one hundred dollars. Tom saves his money every week. He puts coins in a piggy bank. After many weeks, Tom has enough money. He is very happy to buy his new bike!

questions.question: What does Tom want to buy?
questions.source_sentence: Tom wants to buy a new bike.

questions.question: How much does the bike cost?
questions.source_sentence: The bike costs one hundred dollars.

questions.question: Where does Tom put his coins?
questions.source_sentence: He puts coins in a piggy bank.
